SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3552
23 / 4 / 32
Louza Police
April 22nd, 1932. XX

FURTHER
DISAPPEARANCE OF A 19TH ROUTE ARMY OFFICER FROM THE
ORIENTAL HOTEL

D. I. Hall

Sir,

At 9.30 a.m. this inst, D. I. Hall and C. C. I. Tang Tsu, went to No. 1361 Sinza Road, the Maritime Customs, Headquarters and interviewed Mr. Fu Yang Sih Bah.

Mr. Fu Ying is the Advisor to the 19th Route Army and is in charge of all accounts and expenditure for them. With- out his signature nothing is valid, and no money may be paid out. He stated that on the 18-4-32, the man Liang ( 梁 ) telephoned for him, but as he could not see him owing to business, he arranged to meet him on the following morning between 9 a.m. and 11 a.m. At about 11 a.m. on the 19th, Lian came and saw him and discussed with him the accounts and expenditure of the Mine-laying Flotilla, at Jiangyin and as a result of this, he gave Liang a cheque on the China State Bank for $2,200., for the monthly expenses of his unit.

This bears out entirely the statement of the man Chang ( 張 ).

Mr. Fu Yang was then asked regarding the character of the missing man, and he said that from all enquiries he had made, Liang was a very good man, not given to dissipation in any form and thoroughly to be trusted. On discussing his disappearance, Mr. Fu Yang stated that two theories could be dismissed entirely. Firstly, the theory of Kidnapping as Liang is not a rich man, nor well known, and secondly his abduction by a Foreign Power. This latter had been suggested

编号 D 3552
1932年4月23日
老闸捕房
1932年4月22日。XX

关于
第十九路军军官从
汇中饭店失踪的进一步报告

警督察 Hall

先生，

本月22日上午9时30分，警督察 Hall 和华探长唐祖前往新闸路1361号海关总部，会见了傅仰西巴（Fu Yang Sih Bah）先生。

傅英（Fu Ying）先生是第十九路军的顾问，负责该军的所有账目和支出。未经其签字，任何事项均无效，亦不得支付任何款项。他称，1932年4月18日，梁（Liang）先生给他打电话，但因公务繁忙未能见面，遂约定次日上午9时至11时之间会面。19日上午11时许，梁前来见他，并与他讨论了江阴布雷舰队的账目和支出事宜。据此，他给梁开具了一张中国银行支票，金额为2,200元，作为其部队的月度经费。

这完全证实了张（Chang）先生的陈述。

随后询问傅仰先生关于失踪者的品行，他说，经多方查访，梁是一个非常好的人，没有任何形式的放荡行为，完全值得信赖。在讨论其失踪原因时，傅仰先生表示可以完全排除两种推测。第一，绑架之说，因为梁并非富人，也不出名；第二，被外国势力绑架之说。后者曾被他人提出，

Louza Police
April 22nd, 1932.

DISAPPEARANCE OF A 19TH ROUTE ARMY OFFICER FROM THE
ORIENTAL HOTEL

D. I. Hall

by others as the theory was that he might have been held
responsible by them for the attempt at the destruction of a
(Japanese) foreign warship in Shanghai harbour.
H.R.
This only left the question of internal dissention in his
unit, and regarding this Mr. Su Yang stated that his enquiries
showed that prior to leaving Canton, there were differences
amongst them, but what these differences were, he either could
not or would not, say. Regarding this, Mr. Su Yang has sent
investigators to Kiangyin to try and find if the differences
were such as to be responsible for the disappearance of Liang,
and the results of these enquiries will be transmitted to the
Police when available.

Later, this p.m., information received shows that whilst
this Mine-laying unit was in Shanghai, other differences arose
as a result of which, two men of the party left (One was dis-
missed as the result of a telegram sent to Canton by Liang and
the other absconded from Kiangyin as the result of the loss of
a secret document.) Both these men are believed to be in Shang-
hai, and a search is being instituted for them, as it is possi-
ble that they are responsible for Liang's disappearance.

The watchmen of the Oriental Hotel and the Great Eastern
Hotel, who were on duty at the time of the disappearance, were
questioned, but they were unable to furnish any information as
they stated that many motor cars, came and went at their res-
pective doorways, so that they could not remember any particu-
lar one.

N.R. 23/4                                          D.I. Hall D.I.

关于
第十九路军军官从
汇中饭店失踪的报告

警督察 Hall

理由是认为他可能因上海港内试图摧毁一艘（日本）外国军舰的事件而被他们追究责任。
H.R.
这就只剩下其部队内部不和的问题。关于这一点，苏仰（Su Yang）先生称，他的调查显示，在离开广州之前，他们内部存在分歧，但这些分歧具体是什么，他要么不知道，要么不愿说。关于此事，苏仰先生已派遣调查人员前往江阴，试图查明这些分歧是否足以导致梁的失踪，调查结果一旦获得，将转交警方。

稍后，今天下午收到的消息显示，当这支布雷部队在上海期间，发生了其他分歧，导致该团体中的两人离开（一人因梁向广州发送的电报而被解职，另一人因丢失秘密文件而从江阴潜逃）。据信这两人目前都在上海，正在对他们展开搜寻，因为他们可能对梁的失踪负有责任。

对失踪发生时值班的汇中饭店和大东饭店的门卫进行了讯问，但他们无法提供任何信息，因为他们称当时有许多汽车在各自门口进出，因此记不住任何特定的车辆。

N.R. 1932年4月23日                                          警督察 Hall 警督察

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3558.
Date 23 / 4 / 32

Louza Police
April 21st, 1932.xx

FURTHER DISAPPEARANCE OF A 19TH ROUTE ARMY OFFICER FROM THE
ORIENTAL HOTEL

D.I.Hall
〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

Sir,

Further enquiries have been made during the 21-4-32 but
nothing further has been found that would help to clear up
this case.

The missing man is practically a stranger to Shanghai,
having come from Canton only about one month ago, and as he
is not a man of means, it does not seem that he has been kid-
napped for ransom.

The theory that he had absconded with funds is also proved
abortive as he was not in possession of any funds other than
his own, so that it would seem that there is some political
reason for his disappearance, at present not discernable..

Statements from the boys of the Oriental Hotel and his
friend are attached but these thrown no light on the reason
for his disappearance.

Enquiries are being continued on the 22-4-32 and
will form the subject of a further report.

〔此处转录不清：手写签名及 D.I. 缩写〕

N.Robertson
A description of the missing man has been
circulated to all stations, French Police for
inquiries at hotels, lodging houses, hospitals
without result.
Stations have also been requested to make
inquiries at all garages for a motor car
sent to the Oriental Hotel between 8:30 & 10:30
April 19. but no results have been obtained
N.Robertson.
C.D.I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别分部登记室
编号 D 3558。
日期 1932年4月23日

老闸捕房
1932年4月21日。xx

关于
第十九路军军官从
汇中饭店失踪的进一步报告

警督察 Hall
〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

先生，

1932年4月21日进行了进一步查访，但未发现有助于澄清此案的新线索。

失踪者对上海来说几乎是个陌生人，大约一个月前才从广州来到此地，且他并非富有之人，因此似乎不太可能是为了勒索赎金而遭绑架。

他携款潜逃的推测也被证明不成立，因为他除了自己的钱之外并未持有任何资金，因此看来他的失踪可能有某种政治原因，目前尚不明显。

附上了汇中饭店侍者和其朋友的供词，但这些供词并未揭示其失踪的原因。

查访工作将于1932年4月22日继续进行，并将作为后续报告的主题。

〔此处转录不清：手写签名及 D.I. 缩写〕

N. Robertson
失踪者的体貌特征描述已分发至各捕房，法国警察也在旅馆、寄宿处和医院进行了查询，但均无结果。
还要求各捕房在所有车行查询1932年4月19日8:30至10:30之间送往汇中饭店的汽车，但未获得结果。
N. Robertson.
首席副督察

page_data.en:
Soo Seu Tau (        )

Hankow
Louza Station        21-4-32

Soo Seu Tau (        ) age 44, Hankow, Taepoo Road, employed
as No.1 Boy on the 5th floor Oriental Hotel since the Hotel
opened.
    At about 8.30p.m. on the 19-4-32 I was sittin, at my desk
in the corridor near Room No.530, when Liang (        ), the occu-
pant of the Room came up and told me that as he might be away
all night, I was to lock the room and let no one else in there
but his room mate Tsang (        ). He then joked with for a while
and then went back into his room, and I did not see him again
as I had finished my tour of duty and went home shortly after-
wards.
    The following morning, Tsang appeared anxious regarding the
whereabouts of Liang so I told him what Liang had told me about
being away for the night.
page_data.zh:
苏寿头 (Soo Seu Tau) (        )

汉口
老闸捕房        1932年4月21日

苏寿头 (Soo Seu Tau) (        )，44岁，汉口人，住大浦路（Taepoo Road），自汇中饭店开业以来受雇为该店五楼的一号侍者。
    1932年4月19日晚上8点30分左右，我正坐在530号房间附近走廊的办公桌前，这时530号房间的住客梁（Liang）(        ) 走过来告诉我，因为他可能整晚不在，我要把房间锁好，除他的室友曾（Tsang）(        ) 外，不让其他人进入。然后他和我开了一会儿玩笑，就回房间去了，之后我没再见到他，因为我结束了值班，不久后就回家了。
    第二天早上，曾（Tsang）对梁的下落显得很焦急，所以我告诉他梁跟我说他要外出一晚的事。

page_data.en:
Tsang Ts Kwok (          )

Canton
Louza Station        21-4-32

Tsang Ts Kwok (          ), 37, Canton, Captain of Chinese
Navy, Room 530 Oriental Hotel.
    On the 16-4-32 I and Liang Taung (          ) my superior
officer came to Shanghai from Kiangyin in order to get some
money for the pay of a mine laying flotilla at Kiangyin. As it
was a Saturday when we arrived we were unable to do anything in the
the matter until Monday, so we lazed around the Hotel. On Monday
morning Liang went to see Bu Yang Sih Bah (          ) but was
unable to meet him, so a meeting was arranged for Tuesday morning
at 11.a.m. in the Customs Headquarters on Sinza Road. This
meeting was successful and Liang obtained a cheque for $2,200.
which I took to the China State Bank, 130 Ningpo Road and cashed,
keeping the money in the room. I then stayed in the room till
about 7.30p.m. when I went to Canton Road to buy some collars
and there I met a friend of mine from Kiangyin named Ying Tei
Zung (          ) and he and I went to a Sing Song House, address
unknown, for a short while. Here we met another man, a friend of
Ying's and the three of us went to a cinema. After the cinema,
we then all went to my room where we arrived at about 12.05a.m.
and called some Sing Song Girls and eventually they all left at
about 1.30a.m. When I entered the room, I found the note left
by Liang, so when my friends had gone I lay on the bed, but did
not go to sleep as I had locked the door on the inside and expected
Liang to come back.
    I did not sleep at all and got up at about 10.a.m. and
began looking for Liang in a teashop we were in the habit of using
and when he did not return, I went back to the hotel. I then asked
page_data.zh:
曾治国 (Tsang Ts Kwok) (          )

广州
老闸捕房        1932年4月21日

曾治国 (Tsang Ts Kwok) (          )，37岁，广州人，中国海军上尉，住汇中饭店530号房间。
    1932年4月16日，我和我的上级长官梁唐（Liang Taung）(          ) 从江阴来到上海，目的是为江阴布雷舰队领取薪饷。因为我们到达时是星期六，所以在星期一之前无法办理此事，于是我们在酒店里闲逛。星期一上午，梁去见傅仰西巴（Bu Yang Sih Bah）(          )，但没能见到他，于是约定星期二上午11点在新闸路海关总部会面。这次会面很成功，梁拿到了一张2,200元的支票，我将其带到宁波路130号的中国银行兑现，并将钱留在房间里。然后我一直待在房间里，直到晚上7点30分左右，我去广东路买了一些衣领，在那里我遇到了一位来自江阴的朋友英铁宗（Ying Tei Zung）(          )，我和他去了一家地址不详的歌厅待了一会儿。在那里我们遇到了另一个人，是英的朋友，我们三人去看了电影。看完电影后，我们都回到了我的房间，大约在凌晨12点05分到达，叫了几位歌女，最终她们在凌晨1点30分左右全部离开。当我进入房间时，发现了梁留下的纸条，所以等朋友们走后，我躺在床上，但没有睡觉，因为我从里面锁了门，预计梁会回来。
    我根本没睡，大约在上午10点起床，开始在我们常去的茶馆寻找梁，当他没有回来时，我回到了酒店。然后我问了

page_data.en:
-2-

Tsang Ts Kwok

the boys of the Hotel and the "No.1" told me that Liang had said
that he expected to be out all night. I then waited around until
about 5.p.m. when I met Daung Lai Kyi (      ) and we then
tried to get into touch with Eu Yang Sih Bih by telephone but
were unsuccessful. At about 8.p.m. a telephone message came
for me from an unknown person, saying that Liang had been abduct-
ed by Japanese and that I had better leave the Hotel if I valued
my life. I then became very frightened and went to Central Police
Station to see my old school friend Lo Tsuan Shih (      ) and
we then took the $2,200 to the Customs Headquarters for safekeep-
ingm for which I have a receipt from a man named Chang (      ).
Regarding the $150,000. nothing definite had been arranged
about that. When we came to Shanghai for the pay of the men, we
thought it would be a good opportunity to get some money for
mines and torpedoes, but as, when we were here, we received
notice that they were not required, we did not take any action.
page_data.zh:
-2-

曾治国

酒店的侍者，“一号”侍者告诉我，梁说他预计整晚都不在。然后我一直在周围等到下午5点左右，遇到了邓来基（Daung Lai Kyi）(      )，我们试图通过电话联系欧阳西比（Eu Yang Sih Bih），但未成功。晚上8点左右，一个陌生人给我打来电话，说梁被日本人绑架了，如果我想保命，最好离开酒店。我当时非常害怕，就去中央捕房见我的老同学罗传世（Lo Tsuan Shih）(      )，然后我们将2,200元送到海关总部保管，我从一个叫张（Chang）(      ) 的人那里拿到了收据。关于那15万元，还没有做出任何明确的安排。当我们来上海领取士兵薪饷时，我们认为这是一个为水雷和鱼雷筹集资金的好机会，但是，当我们在这里时，收到通知说不再需要这些物资，所以我们没有采取任何行动。

page_data.en:
Tseu Sing Tsaung (        ),

Ningpo
Louza Station        21-4-32

Tseu Sing Tsaung (        ) 23, Ningpo, 321 Kyung Zen Li,
Elgin Road employed as Boy No.122 of the Oriental Hotel. I have
been employed here for over a year, prior to which I was employed
in Dollar Hotel, Avenue Edward VII French Town for 2 years, and
I am guaranteed by the Hong Yuen (        ) Restaurant, Seward
Road.

At present, from the 19th inst, I am on duty on the
5th floor of the Oriental Hotel from 12 noon to 12 A.M. and
together with other boys we look after 14 rooms, Nos.524-537.

Just over a week ago Room No.530 was rented by two
Cantonese named Liang (        ) and Tsang (        ) whom, I heard
from the accountants office, were officers of the 19th Route
Army. They did not receive many visitors, but were friendly
with the occupants of Room No.526 opened by a man named Taung
(        ), who in turn was friendly with the occupant of Room No.
532, named Yoong (        ) and the occupants of these 3 rooms since
about the 16th when Room No.526 was rented, were always visiting
each other.

Just about 9.p.m. on the 19-4-32, I was on duty when the
telephone in the passage rang. I answered the phone and a Can-
tonese asked me to call the man Liang from Room 530. He spoke
in Cantonese which I understood. I went in the room where Liang
was lying on the sofa reading a paper, fully dressed except for
his shoes. He answered the phone in his slippers. At the phone
I heard Liang say "Yes I am Mr. Liang of No.530" Pause. "Alright
alright") and he then rang off and went to the lavatory. A
minute or so later he came out and went back to his room, put
page_data.zh:
徐星庄 (Tseu Sing Tsaung) (        )，

宁波
老闸捕房        1932年4月21日

徐星庄 (Tseu Sing Tsaung) (        )，23岁，宁波人，住爱文义路（Elgin Road）景兴里321号，受雇为汇中饭店122号侍者。我在这里工作已超过一年，此前我在法租界爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）的美元饭店（Dollar Hotel）工作了2年，由赛华路（Seward Road）的鸿运（Hong Yuen）(        ) 餐馆担保。

目前，从本月19日起，我在汇中饭店五楼值班，时间为中午12点至午夜12点，与其他侍者一起照管14个房间，即524-537号。

大约一周前，530号房间被两名广东人租用，名叫梁（Liang）(        ) 和曾（Tsang）(        )，我从会计室听说他们是第十九路军的军官。他们接待的客人不多，但与526号房间的住客唐（Taung）(        ) 关系友好，而唐又与532号房间的住客杨（Yoong）(        ) 关系友好。自从大约16日526号房间出租以来，这三个房间的住客总是互相串门。

1932年4月19日晚上9点左右，我正在值班，这时走廊里的电话响了。我接起电话，一个广东人让我叫530号房间的梁先生听电话。他用广东话讲话，我能听懂。我走进房间，梁正穿着除鞋子以外的全套衣服，躺在沙发上看报纸。他穿着拖鞋去接电话。在电话旁，我听到梁说：“是的，我是530号的梁先生。”停顿。“好的，好的。”然后他挂断电话，去了洗手间。大约一分钟后，他出来回到房间，穿上

page_data.en:
-2-

Tseu Sing Tsaung

his shoes on and came out with his hat on also. He then told
the No.1 Boy who happened to be present, to lock the room and
let no one in but Tsang, who lived there with him.
He then walked up and down in the corridor for a while
until a man wearing a black long gown and small Chinese hat came
up and asked me for Room No.530. I then pointed out Mr. Liang,
who came over and asked this man where he had come from. He
mentioned a road, the name of which I could not hear distinctly
and then told Liang that the car was waiting outside the Great
Eastern Hotel. (No parking is allowed on Nanking Road at this
Hotel entrance)
The Chauffeur then left and Liang again went into his room
for a short while and on coming out, told me to lock the door and
he entered the lift and descended. This was at about 9.30p.m. and
was the last I saw of him.
page_data.zh:
-2-

徐星庄

鞋子，也戴上了帽子。然后他告诉当时在场的一号侍者，把房间锁好，除了和他同住的曾以外，不要让任何人进去。
然后他在走廊里来回走了一会儿，直到一个穿着黑色长袍、戴着小帽子的男人走过来，向我询问530号房间。于是我指了指梁先生，他走过来问这个人是从哪里来的。那人提到了一条路，名字我没听清，然后告诉梁，车在大东饭店外面等着。（该酒店门口南京路上不允许停车）
司机随后离开，梁又进房间待了一小会儿，出来时让我锁门，他进入电梯下楼。这大约是晚上9点30分，也是我最后一次见到他。

Copy for Q.C. (S.B.)
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. W.R.

File No............
Louza Station,
Date 20th April 19 32

REPORT

Subject (in full)....Disappearance of a 19th Route Army Officer from the
Oriental Hotel.

Made by....D.I.Hall....................Forwarded by...Jos. L. Adams
C.I.

SIR,
At 11.30 p.m. this inst., Interpreter Loo Tsuan Shih of Central
Police Station Charge Room, came to the Station with a Cantonese
named Tsang Ts Kwok (張志國) and reported that another Cantonese
named Liang Taung (梁堂 ) had been missing since 9.30 p.m. the
19-4-32.

Enquiries were made by D.I.Hall, D.S. Burton and C.L.S.130 when
the following facts were learned.

The two men, Tsang Ts Kwok (張志國) and Liang Taung (梁堂 )
are Captains in the Cantonese Flotilla of the Chinese Navy/attached to
the 19th Route Army at Kiangyin. On the 15-4-32 they both
returned to Shanghai from Kiangyin in order to await a sum of
$150,000.00 which was to be used for the purchasing of materials
for the making of mines. This money was to be sent to them by
Admiral Lung Tsah from Hongkong, after previous due warning having
been sent them.

As far as can be ascertained at present, no money has been
forwarded. On arrival in Shanghai, they booked Room No.530 of
the Oriental Hotel and have been staying there since. On the
night of the 19-4-32 the man Tsang Ts Kwok left the Hotel at 7.30
p.m. and returned at 12 m.n. after having been taken to a cinema

事由（全称）____ 一名第十九路军军官从汇中饭店失踪案。

呈报人 ____ 警司霍尔（D.I. Hall）____ 转呈人...约瑟夫·L·亚当斯（Jos. L. Adams）
巡官

先生，
本月20日晚上11时30分，中央捕房值班室译员罗传诗（Loo Tsuan Shih）偕同一名名为张志国（Tsang Ts Kwok）的广东人来到本捕房，报告称另一名名为梁堂（Liang Taung）的广东人自1932年4月19日晚上9时30分起失踪。

经警司霍尔、副巡官伯顿（D.S. Burton）及华探第130号调查，获悉以下事实。

张志国（張志國）与梁堂（梁堂）二人均为中国海军广东舰队（隶属驻江阴的第十九路军）的上尉。1932年4月15日，二人从江阴返回上海，以等待一笔金额为150,000.00元的款项，该款项拟用于购买制造水雷的材料。此前已向他们发出适当预警，这笔钱将由龙萨（Lung Tsah，音译）海军上将从香港寄给他们。

据目前查明，尚无款项汇出。抵达上海后，他们预订了汇中饭店530号房间，并一直居住于此。1932年4月19日晚，张志国于晚上7时30分离开饭店，后被其两位朋友带去看电影，于午夜12时返回。

On his return he found a chit lying on the table in the room
written by the man Liang Taung, in which he stated that he had gone
to visit a man named Lu Yang (陆扬) living at No.2 Hsien Road off
Yu Yuen Road, who is an advisor to the 19th Route Army. He thought
nothing of this but went to bed and even when Liang Taung did not
return during the day of the 20-4-32 he was under the impression
that he was staying with Lu Yang. However at about 8.30 p.m.
20-4-32 he received a telephone call from an unknown Chinese, speaking
Mandarin dialect, who warned him to leave his room in the
hotel if he wished to remain alive, and that the other man had been
taken away by Japanese. He was unable to obtain the name of the
person telephoning. He then realised that something was wrong and
got into touch with the interpreter whom he knew whilst at School
in Canton, and the report was made to the Station.
Enquiries were immediately made at the house of Lu Yang but this
man strenuously denied having sent for Captain Liang, as all the
business he had had with him had been completed.
Further enquiries were made at the Hotel but as the boys on duty
at the time of the occurrence were not present, it was not possible
to get any information from them. They will be questioned on the

回到房间后，他发现桌上有一张由梁堂留下的便条，称他前去拜访居住在愚园路仙霞路（此处原文为Hsien Road off Yu Yuen Road，疑指仙霞路或类似小路，暂按音译处理或保留原意，但根据上海地名习惯，Yu Yuen Road即愚园路，Hsien Road可能指“县路”或特定小弄，此处依原文语境译为“愚园路旁仙霞路2号”或保留路名音译，鉴于历史地名复杂性，若Hsien Road确指某路，通常可能是“县前街”等，但结合上下文“off Yu Yuen Road”，更可能是愚园路支路。注：历史上愚园路附近并无标准译名为Hsien Road的主干道，此处忠实原文译为“愚园路旁仙霞路2号”或按音译“贤路”。考虑到译者要求，若不确定保留原文。但此处“Hsien”极可能是“Xian”即“仙”或“县”。鉴于陆扬身份，暂译为“愚园路旁仙霞路2号”并在括号注明不确定性，或者严格按规则4，若不确定保留原文。规则3说能确定的用通行中文，不确定的保留原文。Hsien Road在上海地图中不常见，故保留英文加注。）*修正：根据规则3，不确定保留原文并加括号注明(音译)。故译为：愚园路旁贤路（Hsien Road，音译）2号*

便条中称，他去拜访一位名叫陆扬（Lu Yang）的人，此人住在愚园路旁贤路（Hsien Road，音译）2号，是第十九路军的顾问。张志国对此并未在意，随即上床睡觉。即使在整个1932年4月20日白天梁堂均未返回，他仍以为梁堂是宿在陆扬处。然而，在1932年4月20日晚上8时30分左右，他接到一个陌生中国人的电话，对方讲官话，警告他若想保命就立刻离开饭店房间，并称另一人已被日本人带走。他未能获知打电话者的姓名。随后他意识到情况不妙，便联系了一位他在广州求学时认识的译员，并向本捕房报案。

警方立即前往陆扬住所查询，但该人强烈否认曾召请梁堂上尉前来，称他与梁堂的所有事务均已办结。

警方又在饭店进行了进一步查询，但由于事发时当值的侍者不在场，无法从他们那里获得任何信息。他们将于

Toi Kyi, who is a friend of the absent man. He is a Lieut of the
19th Route Army, living at No.4 Tatung Road, but having a room
No.529 in the Oriental Hotel for amusement. At the time that
the man Liang Taung received the telephone message, about 9.30p.m.
he was present and Liang remarked to him on the lateness of the
hour. A few minutes later, a chauffeur, description at present
unknown, and not seen by the man Toong, called for Liang and left
with him, presumably in a motor car, the number of which is
unknown. There does not at present appear to be any reason for
this man being kidnapped, and until further enquiries are made
regarding the $150,000.00, we cannot say that he has absconded
with this amount. Further enquiries are being prosecuted on the
21-4-32 and will be the subject of a further report.

1932年4月21日接受询问。从失踪者的朋友董礼基（Toong Toi Kyi）处获得少量信息。董礼基是第十九路军的中尉，住在大通路4号，但在汇中饭店529号房间有一个房间供娱乐之用。梁堂接到电话留言时（约晚上9时30分），董礼基在场，梁堂还向他感叹时间已晚。几分钟后，一名司机（目前特征不详，且未被董礼基看见）来接梁堂，二人随即离开，推测是乘坐汽车，车牌号码不详。目前看来，此人被绑架似乎没有任何理由，在对150,000.00元款项进行进一步调查之前，我们不能断定他是携款潜逃。1932年4月21日将继续进行深入调查，并将另行提交报告。

A.R.
